messages:
Derek (AE): Quick sync — ACME wants a POC that proves generative meeting summaries and semantic search over docs. They asked for a 4-week window starting next Tue. Need SE/Eng hour estimates and security questionnaire answers by EOD so we can finalize the proposal.

Samira (SE): I can run the demo flow and one integration pairing session. Ballpark SE time: 20–28h (prep, run, docs). If they want a connector to their internal CMS it\u2019ll add ~6h.

Jenna (Eng): I\u2019ll own model onboarding, test harness, and fallback wiring. Engineering estimate: 30h including infra tests. If we reuse redwood-open-embedding quant profile it\u2019s less.

Liam (Pricing): For hosted POC: recommend usage cap with a soft overage rate. If they require Dedicated for SLA/throughput, we should quote one month reserved capacity plus setup fee. Roughly cost-to-Redwood for hosted POC: ~$1.8k in infra.

Priya (Security): Got the questionnaire. Main blockers: HSM requirement and log retention policy. Short answers: VPC peering + KMS support available; HSM depends on contract (we can route to customer HSM in Private). I\u2019ll need legal + infra to sign off; ETA 48h.

Mika (Customer): Preference is hosted unless security can\u2019t be satisfied. Success metrics: median summary quality rated >=4/5 on a 100-sample blind eval, top-3 retrieval recall >=82%, and 95p latency <200ms at typical load.

Derek (AE): Ok — let\u2019s write crisp acceptance criteria and a milestone plan. Also flag any lead times (e.g., Dedicated provisioning).

Samira (SE): Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Accuracy: 4/5 median on human eval of 100 prompts
- Retrieval: top3 recall	682%
- Latency: 95p <200ms under baseline query profile
- Deliverables: live demo, runbook, sample eval report

Jenna (Eng): Proposed timeline (4 weeks):
Week 0 (pre-Kickoff): security Q answers, confirm scope
Week 1: model + embeddings onboarding, baseline evals
Week 2: integration with customer data, tuning
Week 3: stability testing, final demo, handoff docs
If Dedicated chosen: add 2-week infra lead to start of Week 1.

Samira (SE): Owners & hours:
- Samira (SE): 24h (demo + runbook + eval setup)
- Jenna (Eng): 30h (model + infra)
- Priya (Security): 6h (Q answers + review)
- Liam (Pricing): 3h (quote + paperwork)
- Derek (AE): 5h (coord, status updates)
Note: add +6h to SE if custom connector required.

Liam (Pricing): Also note billing needs: for hosted POC we put a $X cap and invoice any overage monthly. For Dedicated, require 1-month prepay for reserved node.

Priya (Security): Customer asked for non-retention of raw inputs. We can offer limited retention and allow them to opt out; will document in the runbook and legal addendum.

Derek (AE): Action list:
- @Samira: assemble 100-sample prompt set and demo scripts by Mon EOD
- @Jenna: confirm model variant and infra plan by Tue noon
- @Priya: post completed security answers and legal flags within 48h
- @Liam: draft hosted vs dedicated pricing appendix by Wed

Mika (Customer): Can we lock kickoff Tue 10am PT? I\u2019ll upload a sample dataset and the 100 queries.

Samira (SE): Confirmed — I\u2019ll use their samples for the eval.

Jenna (Eng): I\u2019ll check if we can reuse the existing quant profile and tag infra for a Dedicated slot if requested.

Priya (Security): Uploaded a partial Q response to this thread; legal will comment.

Derek (AE): Thanks all — if estimates change, update thread by EOD. I\u2019ll circulate the POC charter after kickoff.

Samira (SE): Small update — +2h for rehearsal/demo polish.

Derek (AE): Noted. Closing for now; will reopen after kickoff.
